description: This source file implements management functions for the Bwrm Page Manager Object in the Broadway Web Resource Manager system. It provides functions to get page counts, retrieve the oldest page, get, add, delete individual pages, and delete all pages within the page management system.

classes.name: PBWRM_PAGE_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing the Page Manager Object which manages a collection of cooked pages.

classes.name: PBWRM_COOKED_PAGE_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing a cooked page object including methods for matching paths, managing timestamps, and reference counting.

methods.name: ULONG BwrmPmoGetPageCount(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Returns the total number of pages managed by the Page Manager.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BwrmPmoGetOldestPage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest cooked page based on timestamp.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BwrmPmoGetPage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * root_path,char * file_path)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific cooked page matching the given root and file paths, updating its timestamp and reference count.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmPmoAddPage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * root_path,char * file_path,ANSC_HANDLE hCookedPage)
methods.description: Adds a new cooked page to the manager, updating the cache and potentially removing the oldest page if capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmPmoDelPage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * root_path,char * file_path)
methods.description: Deletes a specific cooked page identified by root and file paths.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmPmoDelAllPages(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes all cooked pages from the manager, stopping the cache timer if no pages remain.
